description: Removes a subscriber from the status page. Irreversible: the person stops receiving emails and can only re-subscribe themselves on the public page. Subscriber ids come from `status_page_subscriber_list`.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: status_page_subscriber_delete
title: Delete a subscriber from status page
